title: Mariah was a fantastic guide!!
text: Mariah was my guide! What an excellent way to begin a visit of Barcelona!! Mariah was warm and personable with a great sense of humor and very professional!! Everyone was friend by mid-way through tour. Excellent food and drinks with lots of variety and Mariah was a great resource for most anything!!

title: Barcelona Tapas tour
